capabilities: Zoom into a heading, list, paragraph, or selection and hide the rest
Show a sticky breadcrumb navigation bar with an outline submenu
Navigate to parent, sibling, or next/previous headings via commands and hotkeys
Persist and restore the last zoom range per note
Click list bullets to zoom in
disambiguation: Not an image or canvas zoom tool; it zooms the editor view into headings and lists.
extras: Distributed primarily through BRAT as a beta plugin; also requires enabling 'Fold heading' and 'Fold indent' in Editor settings. Documentation is provided in both English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of Obsidian Zoom by Viacheslav Slinko.
problem: Obsidian's folding hides content but offers no way to zoom into a section and navigate between headings and list items while the rest of the note stays hidden.
